def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Sort by horizontal center and then by vertical center
    bicycle_patches.sort(key=lambda p: (p.horizontal_center, p.vertical_center))

    return bicycle_patches[-1]
